content.title: 2026 Valspar Championship Final Payouts, Prize Money, Winnings: Matt Fitzpatrick Wins
content.text: The PGA Tour wrapped its Florida Swing with the Valspar Championship near Tampa, offering a $9.1 million purse with $1.638 million to the winner.Matt Fitzpatrick got the big check and the satisfaction of going one better than a week ago, when he finished second to Cam Young at the Players Championship. He only made four bogeys all week at the tough Copperhead course and was the only player in the field to shoot four rounds in the 60s.Here are the final payouts for the 2026 Valspar Championship. 2026 Valspar Championship final payoutsWIN: Matt Fitzpatrick, 11 under: $1.638 million2.
